content.description:
Spec: .agentic/specs/independent-git-spec.md

Validate the implementation done by library-developer. Run quality gates, check test coverage on changed code, verify spec compliance.

Verify:
- All 8 acceptance criteria from the spec are met
- agt init handles Scenario A (fresh) and Scenario B (join existing) correctly
- agt init handles edge cases (already initialized, not a git repo, legacy directory, on _agentrack branch)
- agt push stages, commits, and pushes correctly
- agt pull syncs from remote correctly
- Existing commands (create, update, list, view, etc.) work without modification
- Error codes and messages match spec
- Worktree module has proper test coverage

content.content:
Validation Report: Independent Git Branch Worktree Support

Quality Gates: ALL PASS
- Typecheck: PASS
- Lint: PASS
- Tests: 573 pass, 0 fail, 2009 assertions

CRITICAL: src/core/worktree.ts has only 4.75 percent line coverage (no dedicated tests)

Spec Compliance (AC-by-AC):

AC1 (Fresh setup): PASS with 2 caveats
- Orphan branch via git plumbing: CORRECT
- Push to origin: CORRECT (graceful fallback if no remote)
- Gitignore entry added: CORRECT
- Gitignore COMMIT: MISSING (spec says commits the change, implementation only writes)
- Mount worktree: CORRECT
- Initial data files: CORRECT
- Auto-commit after tracker.init(): MISSING (spec AC1 step 6)

AC2 (Join existing): PASS
AC3 (Already initialized): PASS
AC4 (Preconditions): PASS (all 4 error conditions correct)
AC5 (Push): PASS
AC6 (Pull): PASS
AC7 (Existing commands): PASS (all 573 tests still pass)
AC8 (Directory structure): PARTIAL (issues/ dir not in initial orphan commit)

Spec Deviations Found:

1. MEDIUM: Missing .gitignore commit in fresh scenario. Spec AC1 step 3 says commits the change but ensureGitignoreEntry() only writes the file.

2. MEDIUM: Missing auto-commit after tracker.init(). Spec AC1 step 6 says auto-commits the initialized data to the _agentrack branch but initAction() never commits.

3. LOW: initWorktree() returns scenario fresh when already initialized instead of an already_initialized indicator.

Test Coverage Gap:
Prepared a 40-test file (tests/core/worktree.test.ts) covering all public functions and error paths. Could not write the file due to permission restrictions.

Summary: Implementation is functionally sound but needs 2 spec deviation fixes and the worktree test file for adequate coverage.
